ca vimarśātmikāyāṃ vimarśasya ca śabdanātmakatāyāṃ siddhāyāṃ sakalajaganniṣṭhavastunaḥ tadgatasya ca karmaphalasambandhavaicitryasya yat vimarśanaṃ tad eva śāstram iti parameśvarasvabhāvābhinna eva ekaphalasiddhiḥ ekasmād eva āgamāt // abhts_21.4 bhedavāde 'pi samastāgamānām ekeśvarakāryatve 'pi prāmāṇyaṃ tāvat avasthitam prāmāṇyanibandhanasya ekadeśasaṃvādasya avigītatāyā anidaṃtāpravṛtteś ca tulyatvāt parasparabādho viṣayabhedāt akiṃcitkaraḥ // abhts_21.5 brahmahananatanniṣedhavat saṃskārabhedaḥ saṃskārātiśayaḥ tadabhāve kvacit anadhikṛtatvam iti samānam āśramabhedavat phalotkarṣāc ca utkarṣaḥ tatraiva upaniṣadbhāgavat bhinnakartṛkatve 'pi sarvasarvajñakṛtatvam atra saṃbhāvyate taduktatadatiriktayuktārthayogāt nityatve 'pi āgamānāṃ prasiddhiḥ tāvat avaśyopagamyā anvayavyatirekādhyakṣādīnāṃ tatprāmāṇyasya tanmūlatvāt satyaṃ rajataṃ paśyāmi iti hi sauvarṇikādiparaprasiddhyaiva prasiddhir eva āgamaḥ sā kācit dṛṣṭaphalā bubhukṣito bhuṅkte iti bālasya prasiddhita eva tatra tatra pravṛttiḥ nānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ tadā tayoḥ abhāvāt yauvanāvasthāyāṃ tadbhāvo 'pi akiṃcitkaraḥ prasiddhiṃ tu mūlīkṛtya so 'stu kasmaicit kāryāya kācit adṛṣṭavaidehyaprakṛtilayapuruṣakaivalyaphaladā kācit śivasamānatvaphaladā kācit aikyaparyavasāyinī sā ca pratyekam anekavidhā ity evaṃ bahutaraprasiddhipūrṇe jagati yo yādṛśo bhaviṣyan sa tādṛśīm eva prasiddhiṃ balād eva hṛdayaparyavasāyinīm abhimanyate // abhts_21.6 iti riktasya jantoḥ atiriktā vācoyuktiḥ tāsāṃ kāṃcana prasiddhiṃ pramāṇīkurvatā abhyupagantavyam eva āgamaprāmāṇyam iti sa āgama āśrayaṇīyo yatra utkṛṣṭaṃ phalam ity alam anyena // abhts_21.7 saṃvitprakāśaparamārthatayā yathaiva bhāty āmṛśaty api tatheti vivecayantaḥ // abhts_21.8 santaḥ samastamayacitpratibhāvimarśasāraṃ samāśrayata śāstram anuttarātma // abhts_21.9 jissa daḍhapasiddhighaḍie vavahāre soi asmi ṇīsaṃko // abhts_21.10 taha hohi jahuttiṇa pasiddhirūḍhie paramasivo // abhts_21.11 nijadṛḍhaprasiddhighaṭite vyavahāre loka asti niḥśaṅkaḥ // abhts_21.12 tadā bhavati janottīrṇaprasiddhirūḍhaḥ paramaśivaḥ // abhts_21.13

## tsa21-p01
Thus all this fixed and occasional conduct is stated. (21.1) Now of this itself āgama authority is stated. (21.2) Therein: in consciousness-only-made universe, in consciousness, in grasping-natured, of grasping of word-nature established — what is grasping of everything standing and of its karma-fruit-relation-variety — that itself is scripture. Thus Lord-nature-nondifferent is all scripture-connection — really one-fruit-giving. By one-authority-aim therein, by Lord's destiny-power-greatness, in part-part custom of folk. (21.3) Some rooted in Māyā-fitting-division-grasping-natured in Veda-āgama-etc. scripture; others such itself with liberation-conceit in Sāṃkhya-Vaiṣṇava-scripture-and-the-rest; others in distinct-Śiva-nature-grasping-essence in Śaiva Siddhānta-and-the-rest; others in all-made-Lord-nature-grasping-essence in Mataṅga-and-the-rest scripture; some very very rare in all-limitation-void-autonomy-bliss-ultimate-consciousness-made-Lord-nature-grasping-natured in glorious Trika-scripture-course; some by prior-prior-abandoning-course or by leaping — thus one-fruit-success from one scripture alone. (21.4) Even in difference-view, of all scriptures in one-Lord-work-ness too authority so much stands — since of authority-ground, of one-place-agreement, of unblemished, of without-this-ness-proceeding, through equality. Mutual sublation is from subject-difference ineffective. (21.5) As sacrament-difference, sacrament-excess — in its absence somewhere without-authority-ness — thus same as āśrama-difference-like, and from fruit-excess excess. Therein in upaniṣad-Bhāgavata, though distinct-maker-ness, all-all-knowing-made-ness is here conceivable — from stated-and-beyond-stated-reason-content-yoga. In eternity too, of āgamas is custom so much necessarily admitted — since of anvaya-vyatireka-perception-and-the-rest of their authority from that-rootedness. "True, silver, I see" — thus from goldsmith-and-the-rest-other-custom is custom of āgama. That is some seen-fruit: hungry eats, thus of child from custom alone there-there function; not from anvaya-vyatireka then from their absence; in youth-state their becoming too is ineffective. But custom, having made root — so for some for work, some unseen-freedom... fruit-giving, some Śiva-sameness-fruit-giving, some ending-in-unity — and it is in each manifold — thus in much-custom-filled world, who whatever will-be, he such itself custom by force heart-ending imagines. (21.6) Thus of empty being's excess word-logic; to those making some custom authority, to be admitted indeed is āgama-authority. That āgama is to be resorted where highest fruit — so enough of other. (21.7) As shines/grasps so discriminate. (21.8) Good, all-made-consciousness-grasping-essence, resort scripture, unsurpassed-self. (21.9–21.13) "Steady firm-success-gained in business = I without doubt... people-transcending success-gained = supreme Śiva."

## tsa21-p01 — why this book counts
All the fixed and occasional conduct is stated now; what remains is why this book carries authority at all. The argument is one: the universe is consciousness-only, consciousness is grasping, grasping is word-natured — and all of it established — so the grasping of everything that stands, and of the variety of karma-fruit relations, is scripture. Lord-nature-nondifferent, the whole scripture-connection is really one-fruit-giving. One aim, one authority; the divisions by part and part are folk-custom through the Lord's destiny-power. And those divisions are real: some are rooted in scripture that fits Māyā's divisions; some with liberation-conceit in Sāṃkhya-Vaiṣṇava books; some in distinct-Śiva-nature in Śaiva Siddhānta; some in all-made-Lord in Mataṅga; a very few, very rare, in the limitationless form in Trika's course; some by abandoning the earlier, some by leaping. All one fruit from one scripture. Even where schools differ, authority stands: all scriptures work one Lord's work, and their one-place agreement, unblemishedness, and proceeding without "this"-ness are equal. Mutual sublation is ineffective by subject-difference. Sacrament-difference and excess — like āśrama-difference; in absence, sometimes without authority; and from fruit-excess, excess. In the upaniṣad-Bhāgavata, even distinct-maker-ness, all-all-knowing-made-ness is conceivable — from stated and beyond-stated reason-yoga. Eternity too: āgama-custom is necessarily admitted — anvaya-vyatireka-perception-and-the-rest root it. "True, silver, I see" — custom via goldsmith-custom; a hungry child eats by custom alone, no proof needed; in youth the custom's becoming is ineffective. But custom, rooted, may be admitted for some work, some unseen-freedom-nature-principle-dissolution-liberation, some Śiva-sameness, some ending-in-unity — and each individually manifold. So in a world stuffed with custom, whoever will be, imagines by force the custom heart-ending that suits him. Thus the empty being's excess word-logic. To those making some custom authority, this āgama must be admitted — where highest fruit, enough of others. As it shines and grasps, so discriminate. Good men resort to the all-made-consciousness-grasping-essence scripture, the unsurpassed self. (Then the Apabhraṃśa close: steady firm-success in business — I, without doubt; abandoning — success-gained supreme Śiva; firm-success business — world without doubt; then people-transcending success-gained — supreme Śiva.)
